plants.name: Acorn Knight
plants.overview: The {GetName()} is a melee tank with a sword and shield, raising his guard under pressure and able to hurl his shield to stun a target and block the path.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Whenever {GetName()} is not being targeted by a Physical damaging insect, he holds an Attack Stance.\n\nAttack Stance: {GetName()} swings his sword down, dealing {attackDamage * DownStrikeDamagePercent:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, then back up, dealing {attackDamage * UpStrikeDamagePercent:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, to all insects in range on the side his target is on.
sections.details: Whenever {GetName()} is not being targeted by a Physical damaging insect, he holds an Attack Stance.\n\nAttack Stance: {GetName()} swings his sword down, dealing [{DownStrikeDamagePercent * 100f:F0}% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, then back up, dealing [{UpStrikeDamagePercent * 100f:F0}% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, to all insects in range on the side his target is on, with {ConeFalloffPerTarget * 100f:F0}% falloff per extra insect hit down to a {SwingMinDamageMultiplier * 100f:F0}% minimum.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {adpl:F0} per level. [+{adpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Armor by {armorpl} per level. [+{armorpl * effectivePath1Level}]
sections.maxBonus: Increase Attack Damage by {armor * 0.33f:F0}.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: {GetName()} heals himself for {BaseRegenPercent * 100f:F0}% Health per second. After not being damaged for {RegenBoostDelay:F0}s, the healing increases to {BoostedRegenPercent * 100f:F0}% per second. If {GetName()} is being targeted by a Physical damaging insect, he changes into Guard Stance, during which he gains +{DefensiveArmor:F0} Armor, while losing {DefensiveAttackSpeedPenalty * 100f:F0}% Attack Speed and {DefensiveAttackRangePenalty * 100f:F0}% Attack Range. While in Guard Stance, his attacks become an omnidirectional Shield Bash dealing {armor * BashDamagePercent:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}. {PlantData.RetainAggroLine()}
sections.details: {GetName()} heals himself for {BaseRegenPercent * 100f:F0}% Health per second. After not being damaged for {RegenBoostDelay:F0}s, the healing increases to {BoostedRegenPercent * 100f:F0}% per second. If {GetName()} is being targeted by a Physical damaging insect, he changes into Guard Stance, during which he gains [({AcornData?.baseDefensiveArmor ?? 20f:F0}) + ({armorpl:F0}/Lvl.)] Armor, while losing {DefensiveAttackSpeedPenalty * 100f:F0}% Attack Speed and {DefensiveAttackRangePenalty * 100f:F0}% Attack Range. While in Guard Stance, his attacks become an omnidirectional Shield Bash dealing [({(AcornData?.baseBashDamagePercent ?? 0.5f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({bashDmgPl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] Armor {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}. {PlantData.RetainAggroLine()}
upgrades: Increase guard Armor by {armorpl:F0} per level. [+{armorpl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
Increase Shield Bash Armor scaling by {bashDmgPl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{bashDmgPl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Decrease Guard Stance's Attack Speed penalty by {DefensiveAttackSpeedPenaltyReductionPerLevel * 100f:F0}% per level. [-{DefensiveAttackSpeedPenaltyReductionPerLevel * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
sections.maxBonus: Shield Bash inflicts a {BashStunDuration:F2} second Stun on insects hit.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: The {GetName()} throws his shield, stopping at the first insect hit and dealing {armor * SkillDamageArmorPercent:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} and Stunning it for {ShieldStunDuration:F1}s. The shield then sits at the hit location for {skillDuration:F1} [+{SkillDurationMP:F1}] seconds, blocking and Taunting insects, with {shieldHealth:F0} health.\n\nWhile the shield is out, {GetName()} cannot guard, loses {AttackPathArmorBonus:F0} Armor, and gains +{SkillAttackSpeedBonus * 100f:F0}% Attack Speed.
sections.details: The {GetName()} throws his shield, stopping at the first insect hit and dealing [{SkillDamageArmorPercent * 100f:F0}% Armor] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, Stunning it for {ShieldStunDuration:F1}s. The Shield then sits at the hit location for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] [+{durMP * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] seconds, blocking and Taunting insects who stop at it. The Shield has [({data.baseSkillHealth:F0}) + ({hppl:F0}/Lvl.)] health.\n\nWhile the shield is out, {GetName()} cannot guard, loses {AttackPathArmorBonus:F0} Armor, and gains [({(AcornData?.baseSkillAttackSpeedBonus ?? 0.2f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({aspl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] Attack Speed.
upgrades: Increase Shield lifetime by {durpl:F0} seconds per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase Shield health by {hppl:F0} per level. [+{hppl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase Attack Speed bonus by {aspl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath3Level * 100f:F0}%]
sections.maxBonus: Whenever the Shield is healed, its lifetime is extended by 2% of the healing amount, in seconds.\n\nThe Shield gains {baseArmor:F0} Base Armor.
sections.maxBonusDetails: Whenever the Shield is healed, its lifetime is extended by 2% of the healing amount, in seconds.\n\nThe Shield inherits the {DisplayName}'s Base Armor.

plants.name: Aeonium
plants.overview: The {GetName()} is a radiant succulent that fuels the garden's economy , generating sun, and blessing nearby plants to reap far more of it.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Launches an energy ball dealing {attackDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to the first insect hit.
sections.details: Launches an energy ball dealing [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to the first insect hit.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {adpl:F0} per level. [+{adpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rngpl:F2} per level. [+{rngpl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Every 4th shot grants 8 Sun.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Generates {_sunGenerated} Sun every {SunGenInterval:F1}s. Each projectile or melee attack hit by a plant within her radius reduces the timer by {_sunTimerReductionBase:F1}s [+{_sunTimerReductionMP:F2}s].
sections.details: Generates [({(AData?.baseSunGenerated ?? 6)}) + ({sunpl}/Lvl.)] Sun every {passiveCooldown:F0} seconds. Each projectile or melee attack hit by a plant within her radius reduces the timer by [({(AData?.baseSunTimerReduction ?? 0.3f):F1}) + ({sunTimerpl:F1}/Lvl.)] seconds [+{mpMult * 100f:F1}% Magic Power].
upgrades: Increase Sun Generated by {sunpl} per level. [+{sunpl * effectivePath2Level}]
Increase On-Hit Timer Reduction by {sunTimerpl:F1} per level. [+{sunTimerpl * effectivePath2Level:F1}]
sections.maxBonus: Timer reduction also triggers from the {GetName()}'s own attacks.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Grants all plants within range Blessing of the Sun for {skillDuration:F0}s, increasing their Sun yield (both generation and kills) by {SunYieldBonus * 100f:F0}%.
sections.details: Grants all plants within range Blessing of the Sun for {skillDuration:F0} seconds, increasing their Sun yield by [({yieldBase * 100f:F0}%) + ({yieldpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)].
upgrades: Increase Sun yield bonus by {yieldpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{yieldpl * effectivePath3Level * 100f:F0}%]
sections.maxBonus: Plants under Blessing of the Sun also yield +1 Sun when triggering the timer reduction.

plants.name: Aloe Vera
plants.overview: The {GetName()} lobs arcing water droplets that burst on impact. She prioritizes healing injured allies before engaging insects.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Lob a water droplet that bursts on landing, dealing {attackDamage:F0} [+{AttackMaxHealthBonus:F0}] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to all insects within {aoERadius:F1} radius.
sections.details: Lob a water droplet that bursts on landing, dealing [100% Attack Damage + {AttackMaxHealthScaling * 100f:F0}% Max Health] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to all insects within {aoERadius:F1} radius.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rangepl:F1} per level. [+{rangepl * effectivePath1Level:F1}]
Increase Base Max Health by {hppl:F0} per level. [+{hppl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
sections.maxBonus: Increase the splash radius to {baseAoERadius * 2f:F1}.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Water droplets also heal plants, restoring {healAmount:F0} [+{magicPower * 0.22f + HealMaxHealthBonus:F0}] Health and reducing temperature by {tempReduction:F1}, until comfort, for all plants within {aoERadius:F1} radius. If an injured plant is within range, switch targetting to the one with the lowest Health.
sections.details: Water droplets also heal plants, restoring [({baseHealAmount:F0}) + ({healpl:F0}/Lvl.) + 22% Magic Power + {HealMaxHealthScaling * 100f:F0}% Max Health] Health and reducing temperature by [({baseTempReduction:F1}) + ({temppl:F1}/Lvl.)], until comfort, for all plants within {aoERadius:F1} radius. If an injured plant is within range, switch targetting to the one with the lowest Health.
upgrades: Increase Base Healing by {healpl:F0} per level. [+{healpl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
Increase temperature reduction by {temppl:F1} per level. [+{temppl * effectivePath2Level:F1}]
sections.maxBonus: Heals also restore an additional 12% of the target's Missing Health.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Channels for {channelDuration:F1}s, then calls down a Soothing Rain on a targeted area, healing all plants within {baseSkillRadius:F1} radius for {skillHealPerTick:F0} [+{magicPower * 0.14f + SkillHealMaxHealthBonus:F0}] Health and reducing temperature by {baseSkillTempReduction:F1}, until comfort, every {baseSkillHealInterval:F1}s over {skillDuration:F0} seconds. For a total of {totalHealing:F0} Health.
sections.details: Channels for {channelDuration:F1} seconds, then calls down a Soothing Rain on a targeted area, healing all plants within [({data.baseSkillRadius:F1}) + ({radiuspl:F1}/Lvl.)] radius for [({baseSkillHealPerTick:F0}) + ({healpl3:F0}/Lvl.) + 14% Magic Power + {SkillHealMaxHealthScaling * 100f:F0}% Max Health] Health and reducing temperature by {baseSkillTempReduction:F1}, until comfort, every {baseSkillHealInterval:F1} seconds over [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] seconds.
upgrades: Increase Base Healing by {healpl3:F0} per tick per level. [+{healpl3 * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase rain duration by {durpl:F0} seconds per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase rain radius by {radiuspl:F1} per level. [+{radiuspl * effectivePath3Level:F1}]
sections.maxBonus: Overhealing from Soothing Rain accumulates into Drizzle Barrier, shielding plants for up to 120 for {DrizzleBarrierDuration:F0}s.

plants.name: Anemone
plants.overview: The {GetName()} commands the winds to erode and consume her foes, then pulls them into a devastating vortex.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Launches {ProjectileCount} wind balls at the target, each dealing {attackDamage / ProjectileCount:F0} [{100f / ProjectileCount:F0}%] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, and {attackDamage / ProjectileCount * 0.5f:F0} to surrounding insects within a {SplashRadius:F1} radius.
sections.details: Launches {ProjectileCount} wind balls at the target, each dealing [{100f / ProjectileCount:F0}% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, and half that to surrounding insects within a {SplashRadius:F1} radius.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rpl:F2} per level. [+{rpl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Increase projectile count by 3.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Dealing Wind Damage applies {InitialErosionStacks} stacks of Wind Erosion for {ErosionDuration * ErosionProcChance:F1}s, reducing Armor and Magic Resist by {(int)ErosionReductionPerStack} per stack. If the target is already afflicted with Wind Erosion, adds 1 stack instead.
sections.details: Dealing Wind Damage applies [({baseStacks}) + ({spl}/Lvl.)] stacks of Wind Erosion for {ErosionDuration * ErosionProcChance:F1} seconds, reducing Armor and Magic Resist by {(int)baseRed} per stack. If the target is already afflicted with Wind Erosion, adds 1 stack instead.
upgrades: Increase initial Wind Erosion application by {spl} per level. [+{spl * effectivePath2Level}]
Increase Wind Erosion application duration by {procpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{procpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase Wind Erosion duration by {ErosionDurationPerLevel:F0}s per level. [+{ErosionDurationPerLevel * effectivePath2Level:F0}s]
sections.maxBonus: Applies 2 stacks of Wind Erosion instead of 1 when refreshing.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Summon a vortex at target location, dragging insects toward its center while dealing {VortexDamageFlat:F0} [+{VortexDamageMPBonus:F0}] damage every {AData?.vortexTickInterval ?? 0.5f:F1}s within a {VortexRadius:F1} radius, for {skillDuration:F0}s.
sections.details: Summon a vortex at target location, dragging insects toward its center (Pull Strength: [({baseDrag:F2}) + ({dpl:F2}/Lvl.)]) while dealing [({VortexDamageFlat:F0}) + {skillDamageMultiplier * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] damage every {tickInterval:F1}s within a [({baseRadius:F1}) + ({rpl:F2}/Lvl.)] radius, for {skillDuration:F0}s.
upgrades: Increase Vortex Radius by {rpl:F2} per level. [+{rpl * effectivePath3Level:F2}]
Increase Pull Strength by {dpl:F2} per level. [+{dpl * effectivePath3Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: The Vortex becomes airborne.\n\nOn expiry, the vortex detonates, dealing {VortexDetonationFlat:F0} [{(details ? $"{skillDamageMultiplier * 100f:F0}% Magic Power" : $"+{skillDamageMultiplier * magicPower:F0}")}] damage and pushing back all insects caught in it.

plants.name: Begonia
plants.overview: The {GetName()} grows wet flowers that prime nearby insects with water, and sharpens nearby allies' precision and power, blessing them with the strength of water.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Grows wet flowers around her, applying Water primer to insects in contact with them and reducing its internal cooldown by {WaterCooldownReduction:F1}s. Insects in contact with her flowers have {GrassResistanceShredAmount * 100f:F0}% reduced Grass Resistance.
sections.details: Grows wet flowers around her, applying Water primer to insects in contact with them and reducing its internal cooldown by [({(BData?.baseWaterCooldownReduction ?? 2f):F1}s) + ({cdrpl:F1}s/Lvl.)]. Insects in contact with her flowers have [({(BData?.baseGrassResistanceShred ?? 0.12f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({shredpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] reduced Grass Resistance.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Range by {rangepl:F2} per level. [+{rangepl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Water internal cooldown reduction by {cdrpl:F1}s per level. [+{cdrpl * effectivePath1Level:F1}s]
Increase Grass Resistance reduction by {shredpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{shredpl * effectivePath1Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase Water Primer duration by {durpl:0.#}s per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath1Level:0.#}s]
sections.maxBonus: When her Water primer sets off a reaction, the reaction is credited to whoever applied the first primer, using that plant's stats instead of hers.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: The {GetName()} gains {ElementalAffinityBonusBase * 100f:F0}% [+{ElementalAffinityBonusMP * 100f:F0}%] base Elemental Affinity and {GrassDamageBonusBase * 100f:F0}% [+{GrassDamageBonusMP * 100f:F0}%] base Grass Damage.\n\nOther plants within her attack radius are granted Begonia's Blessing, increasing their Elemental Affinity by {BlessingAffinity * 100f:F0}% and Grass Damage by {BlessingGrassDamage * 100f:F0}% ({BlessingShare * 100f:F0}% of her own). Their Germinate triggers detonate {GerminateSpeedupBonus:F1}s earlier.
sections.details: The {GetName()} gains [({(BData?.baseElementalAffinityBonus ?? 0.24f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({eapl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.) + {mpMult * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] base Elemental Affinity and [({(BData?.baseGrassDamageBonus ?? 0.2f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({gdpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.) + {mpMult * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] base Grass Damage.\n\nOther plants within her attack radius are granted Begonia's Blessing, increasing their Elemental Affinity and Grass Damage by [({(BData?.baseBlessingShare ?? 0.85f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({sharepl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] of her own, and making their Germinate triggers detonate [({(BData?.baseGerminateSpeedup ?? 0.5f):F1}s) + ({gspl:F1}s/Lvl.)] earlier.
upgrades: Increase her base Elemental Affinity by {eapl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{eapl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase her base Grass Damage by {gdpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{gdpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase the Begonia's Blessing share by {sharepl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{sharepl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase Germinate speedup by {gspl:F1}s per level. [+{gspl * effectivePath2Level:F1}s]
sections.maxBonus: Begonia's Blessing allows Germinate triggers to critically strike.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Plants within her attack range are granted Blossoming for {skillDuration:F0}s, increasing Attack Speed by {AttackSpeedBonusBase * 100f:F0}% [+{AttackSpeedBonusMP * 100f:F0}%]. While active, dealing Water or Grass damage reduces that insect's own primer cooldown for that element by {PrimerCooldownReduction:F1}s.
sections.details: Plants within her attack range are granted Blossoming for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] seconds, increasing Attack Speed by [({(BData?.baseAttackSpeedBonus ?? 0f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({aspl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.) + {mpMult * 100f:F0}% Magic Power]. upgrades: Increase Attack Speed bonus by {aspl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath3Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase duration by {durpl:F0} second per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase primer cooldown reduction by {pcrpl:F1}s per level. [+{pcrpl * effectivePath3Level:F1}s]
sections.maxBonus: Blossoming plants' Germinate effect has its radius increased by 50%.

plants.name: Bird of Paradise
plants.overview: The {GetName()} focuses its talons on a single foe, striking faster and harder with every hit until even the mightiest insects begin to crumble.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Attacks a single target dealing {attackDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, gaining a stack of Talon Focus, increasing Attack Speed by {TalonFocusASPerStack * 100f:F0}% per stack, up to {TalonFocusCap} stacks.
sections.details: Attacks a single target dealing [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, gaining a stack of Talon Focus, increasing Attack Speed by [({(BOPData?.baseTalonFocusASPerStack ?? 0.04f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({aspl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] per stack, up to {TalonFocusCap} stacks.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {adpl:F0} per level. [+{adpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rpl:F2} per level. [+{rpl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Talon Focus Attack Speed bonus by {aspl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level * 100f:F0}%]
sections.maxBonus: At {TalonFocusCap} stacks of Talon Focus, attacks also deal {(BOPData?.maxStacksHealthPercentDamage ?? 0.05f) * 100f:F0}% of the target's missing health on hit, and grant {MaxStacksAttackSpeedBonus * 100f:F0}% Total Attack Speed while at full stacks.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Each stack of Talon Focus deals an additional {PassiveDamagePerStack:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} on hit.
sections.details: Each stack of Talon Focus deals an additional [({BOPData?.basePassiveDamagePerStack ?? 3f:F0}) + ({dmgpl:F0}/Lvl.)] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} on hit.
upgrades: Increase bonus damage per stack by {dmgpl:F0} per level. [+{dmgpl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
sections.maxBonus: Talon Focus also grants {ArmorShredPerStack * 100f:F0}% Armor Shred per stack. Every {ExtraProcEveryNHits} attack hits against the same target, apply the on-hit effect an additional time.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Grants self Three Talon Strike for {skillDuration:F0}s, increasing Total Attack Speed by {SkillAttackSpeedBonus * 100f:F0}% and allowing attacks to hit 2 additional nearest enemies for the exact same effect.
sections.details: Grants self Three Talon Strike for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] seconds, increasing Total Attack Speed by [({(BOPData?.baseSkillAttackSpeedBonus ?? 0.08f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({aspl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] and allowing attacks to hit 2 additional nearest enemies for the exact same effect.
upgrades: Increase Total Attack Speed bonus by {aspl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath3Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase duration by {durpl:F0} seconds per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}s]
sections.maxBonus: Permanently attacks an additional nearest enemy within a {PermanentExtraTargetRadius:F0} radius of the main target, even outside Three Talon Strike.

plants.name: Bog Iris
plants.overview: The {GetName()} is self-sufficient, providing herself with regeneration as well as generating sun for the garden.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Fires a water bolt at a single target dealing {attackDamage + HealthScalingDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}.
sections.details: Fires a water bolt at a single target dealing [100% Attack Damage] [+{HealthDamageScalingPercent * 100f:F0}% Max Health] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}.
upgrades: Increase Max Health damage scaling by {hppl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{hppl * effectivePath1Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Increase the Sun timer advance per attack hit by 50%.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Every {SunInterval:F1} seconds, generates {BaseSunGenerated} Sun. When damaged, she closes, regenerating {RegenPercentPerSecond * 100f:F0}% Max Health per second (doubled to {RegenPercentPerSecond * 200f:F0}% when out of combat). When healthy, she opens, generating {OpenBonusSun} additional Sun per production. Attacks reduce the Sun generation timer by {ReduceChance:F2} seconds on hit. {PlantData.RetainAggroLine()}
sections.details: Every {SunInterval:F1} seconds, generates {BaseSunGenerated} Sun. When damaged, she closes, regenerating [({(BogData?.baseRegenPercent ?? 0.02f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({regenpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] Max Health per second (doubled when out of combat). When healthy, she opens, generating [({BogData?.baseOpenBonusSun ?? 2}) + ({sunpl}/Lvl.)] additional Sun per production. Attacks reduce the Sun generation timer by [({(BogData?.baseReduceChance ?? 0.35f):F2}) + ({reducepl:F2}/Lvl.)] seconds on hit. {PlantData.RetainAggroLine()}
upgrades: Increase regeneration by {regenpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{regenpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase open-state Sun production by {sunpl} per level. [+{sunpl * effectivePath2Level}]
Increase the Sun timer reduction per hit by {reducepl:F2}s per level. [+{reducepl * effectivePath2Level:F2}s]
Increase Max Health by {hppl:F0} per level. [+{hppl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
sections.maxBonus: Remove the out-of-combat condition from the regeneration (always doubled). Increase Armor by {ClosedArmorBonus:F0} when in closed state.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Target a location. After a brief delay, a geyser erupts, dealing {(BogData?.baseGeyserDamage ?? 0f) + dmgpl * effectivePath3Level:F0} [+{skillDamageMultiplier * magicPower:F0}] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} and knocking all insects airborne by {KnockUpHeight:F0} units.
sections.details: Target a location. After a brief delay, a geyser erupts, dealing [({BogData?.baseGeyserDamage:F0}) + ({dmgpl:F0}/Lvl.) + {skillDamageMultiplier * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} and knocking all insects airborne by [({BogData?.baseKnockUpHeight:F0}) + ({knockpl:F0}/Lvl.)] units within radius [({data.baseSkillRadius:F2}) + ({radiuspl:F2}/Lvl.)].
upgrades: Increase the flat component of geyser damage by {dmgpl:F0} per level. [+{dmgpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase the knock-up height by {knockpl:F0} per level. [+{knockpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase the radius of the geyser by {radiuspl:F2} per level. [+{radiuspl * effectivePath3Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Successful Geyser hits inflict Waterweight for {BogData?.waterweightDuration ?? 8f:F0} seconds, reducing Armor by {BogData?.waterweightArmorShred ?? 20f:F0} and Fall Damage Resistance by {(BogData?.waterweightFallDamageResistanceShred ?? 0.15f) * 100f:F0}%.

plants.name: Cactus
plants.overview: A hardy desert plant that slams everything around it and counters harder the more it's hit.

sections.overview: Absorbs the life essence of an insect, dealing {attackDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, and heals herself for {DrainHealShare * 100f:F0}% of the damage dealt. As long as the {GetName()} has at least {SapCap * SapToChannel:F0} {GoldenSapLabel} available, she may interrupt her attacks to heal a nearby plant below {LowHealthThreshold * 100f:F0}% Health. When her {GoldenSapLabel} is full, she also heals nearby plants below their Max Health, even with insects around. While targeting a plant for healing, she spends her {GoldenSapLabel} to heal a plant for {ChannelHealPerSecond - ChannelHealMP:F0} [+{ChannelHealMP:F0}] health per second. If another plant falls below {CriticalHealthShare * 100f:F0}% Health, she switches to it.
sections.details: Absorbs the life essence of an insect, dealing [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, and heals herself for [{DrainHealShare * 100f:F0}% of the damage dealt]. As long as the {GetName()} has at least {SapToChannel * 100f:F0}% {GoldenSapLabel} available, she may interrupt her attacks to heal a nearby plant below {LowHealthThreshold * 100f:F0}% Health. When her {GoldenSapLabel} is full, she also heals nearby plants below their Max Health, even with insects around. While targeting a plant for healing, she spends her {GoldenSapLabel} to heal a plant for [{RData?.channelHealPerSecond ?? 40f:F0}] [+{(RData?.channelHealMPScaling ?? 0.05f) * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] health per second. If another plant falls below {CriticalHealthShare * 100f:F0}% Health, she switches to it.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {dmgpl:F0} per level. [+{dmgpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rangepl:F1} per level. [+{rangepl * effectivePath1Level:F1}]
Increase the healing to {GoldenSapLabel} depletion ratio by {effpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{effpl * effectivePath1Level * 100f:F0}%]
sections.maxBonus: Healing also benefits from Grass Damage.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Whenever the {GetName()} would get healed from her attacks, she fills up her {GoldenSapLabel} by {SapConversion * 100f:F0}% of the healing, and grants herself {BurgeonLabel}, regenerating {BurgeonHealPerSecond:F0} health per second for {BurgeonDuration:F0} seconds and granting +{BurgeonArmorBase:F0} [+{BurgeonArmorMP:F0}] Armor.\n\nIf the {GetName()} heals a plant while she is blessed by {BurgeonLabel}, she applies the buff at equal strength onto that plant.
sections.details: Whenever the {GetName()} would get healed from her attacks, she fills up her {GoldenSapLabel} by [({(RData?.sapConversion ?? 1f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({convpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] of the healing, and grants herself {BurgeonLabel}, regenerating [({RData?.burgeonHealPerSecond ?? 12f:F0}) + ({burgpl:F0}/Lvl.)] health per second for {BurgeonDuration:F0} seconds and granting [({RData?.burgeonBaseArmor ?? 16f:F0}) + ({armorpl:F0}/Lvl.)] Armor, multiplied by (100% + 1% per Magic Power).\n\nIf the {GetName()} heals a plant while she is blessed by {BurgeonLabel}, she applies the buff at equal strength onto that plant.
upgrades: Increase {GoldenSapLabel} capacity by {cappl:F0} per level. [+{cappl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
Increase Attack to {GoldenSapLabel} conversion ratio by {convpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{convpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase {BurgeonLabel} healing by {burgpl:F0} per second per level. [+{burgpl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
Increase {BurgeonLabel} armor by {armorpl:F0} per level. [+{armorpl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
sections.maxBonus: {BurgeonLabel} applied onto plants including herself also fills up {GoldenSapLabel} at the same rate ({SapConversion * 100f:F0}%).

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Target a tile where a plant has fallen to resurrect it, with the mulches it had. The plant is then healed for {RevivalHealFlat:F0} [+{RevivalMPHeal:F0}] Health.\n\nHealing the dead plant past its Max Health overheals it, granting Verdant Guard equal to the amount of overheal, for {VerdantGuardDuration:F0} seconds.
sections.details: Target a tile where a plant has fallen to resurrect it, with the mulches it had. The plant is then healed for [({RevivalBaseHeal:F0}) + ({RevivalHealPerLevel:F0}/Lvl.) + {(RData?.skillHealMPScaling ?? 0.30f) * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] Health.\n\nHealing the dead plant past its Max Health overheals it, granting Verdant Guard equal to the amount of overheal, for {VerdantGuardDuration:F0} seconds.
upgrades: Increase Revival Heal by {RevivalHealPerLevel:F0} per level. [+{RevivalHealPerLevel * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Reduce Base Skill Cooldown by {Mathf.RoundToInt(cdrpl)}s per level, never below {MinSkillCooldown:F0}s. [-{Mathf.RoundToInt(cdrpl * effectivePath3Level)}s]
sections.maxBonus: The revival heal also fills up her {GoldenSapLabel} at the same rate as her attack's heal ({SapConversion * 100f:F0}%).

plants.name: Snowdrop
plants.overview: The {GetName()} is a frosty flower who marks her prey for her bonded partner to finish off.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Fires a magical snowball at her target, dealing {attackDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}.
sections.details: Fires a magical snowball at her target, dealing [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {adpl:F0} per level. [+{adpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {arpl:F1} per level. [+{arpl * effectivePath1Level:F1}]
sections.maxBonus: +1 Attack target count.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Bond with a plant, excluding other Snowdrops or other plants already bound. Attacks against unmarked targets deal {SnowMarkFlatDamage:F0} + {(SnowMarkPercent - SnowMarkPercentMP) * 100f:F1}% [+{SnowMarkPercentMP * 100f:F1}%] of its Max Health as {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, and apply Snow Mark for {SnowMarkDuration:F0}s. The bonded plant will target at highest priority the Snow Marked insect. Direct damage inflicted by the bonded plant against the Marked insect detonates the Snow Mark, dealing {SnowMarkFlatDamage:F0} + {SnowMarkPercent * 100f:F1}% of the target's Max Health as {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}. If the detonation was dealt by an Attack, deal {SnowMarkPercent * 400f:F1}% Max Health instead.
sections.details: Bond with a plant, excluding other Snowdrops or other plants already bound. Attacks against unmarked targets deal [({SData?.snowMarkFlatDamageBase ?? 12f:F0}) + ({flatpl:F0}/Lvl.)] + [({(SData?.snowMarkDamagePercentBase ?? 0.02f) * 100f:F1}%) + ({pctpl * 100f:F1}%/Lvl.) + {(SData?.snowMarkDamagePercentMP ?? 0.01f) * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] of its Max Health as {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, and apply Snow Mark for {SnowMarkDuration:F0}s. The bonded plant will target at highest priority the Snow Marked insect. Direct damage inflicted by the bonded plant against the Marked insect detonates the Snow Mark, dealing the same bonus as Max Health {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}. If the detonation was dealt by an Attack, deal quadruple that Max Health percentage instead.
upgrades: Increase damage by {flatpl:F0} per level. [+{flatpl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
Increase Max Health damage by {pctpl * 100f:F1}% per level. [+{pctpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F1}%]
sections.maxBonus: Snowdrop can target insects within the bonded plant's attack radius.\n\nIce Beam's range cap is removed.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: {GetName()}'s attacks become an Ice Beam for {skillDuration:F0}s, within which her Attack Speed is fixed at {IceBeamAttackSpeed:F1}.
sections.details: {GetName()}'s attacks become an Ice Beam for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] seconds, within which her Attack Speed is fixed at [({(SData?.iceBeamAttackSpeed ?? 3f):F0}) + ({aspl:F1}/Lvl.)].
upgrades: Increase duration by {durpl:F0} second per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase Attack Speed by {aspl:F1} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath3Level:F1}]
sections.maxBonus: While the Skill is active, the bonded plant gains {PartnerHasteBonus * 100f:F0}% Attack Speed.

plants.name: Stargazer
plants.overview: The {GetName()} sprays a cone of fire that leaves enemies <color=#FF6B1A>Flammable</color>, and can call down a sweeping wall of flame across the entire map.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Sprays fire in a {ConeAngle:F0}° cone, dealing {attackDamage:F0} damage to all insects within it.
sections.details: Sprays fire in a {ConeAngle:F0} degree cone, dealing [100% Attack Damage] damage to all insects within it.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {adpl:F0} per level. [+{adpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rngpl:F2} per level. [+{rngpl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Decrease Total Attack Damage by 33%, but increase Fire Damage by {(SData?.path1MaxFireDamageBonus ?? 0.25f) * 100f:F0}%. Increase Cone Angle by {SData?.path1MaxConeAngleBonus ?? 15f:F0}°.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Dealing Fire Damage applies {StacksPerHit} stack{(StacksPerHit == 1 ? "" : "s")} of Flammable to the target for {FlammableDuration:F1}s, increasing the Burn damage it takes by {FlammableBonusPerStack * 100f:F0}% per stack. Burn effects caused by the {GetName()} last {BurnDurationBonus * 100f:F0}% longer.
sections.details: Dealing Fire Damage applies [({SData?.baseStacksPerHit ?? 1}) + ({spl}/Lvl.)] stack{(StacksPerHit == 1 ? "" : "s")} of Flammable to the target for [({passiveDuration:F1}) + ({ppl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] seconds, increasing the Burn damage it takes by {FlammableBonusPerStack * 100f:F0}% per stack. Burn effects caused by the {GetName()} last [({SData?.baseBurnDurationBonus ?? 0.5f:F0}%) + ({bdpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] longer.
upgrades: Increase Flammable application duration by {ppl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{ppl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase Flammable stacks applied per hit by {spl} per level. [+{Mathf.RoundToInt(spl * effectivePath2Level)}]
Increase Burn duration by {bdpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{bdpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
sections.maxBonus: Increase Elemental Affinity by {(SData?.path2MaxElementalAffinityBonus ?? 0.35f) * 100f:F0}%.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Aim a direction. After a brief delay, a Fire Wave sweeps across the entire map, dealing {(SData?.skillBaseDamage ?? 200f) + (SData?.path3SkillDamagePerLevel ?? 40f) * effectivePath3Level:F0} [+{skillDamageMultiplier * magicPower:F0}] damage to everything in its path, applying {SkillFlammableStacks} stack{(SkillFlammableStacks == 1 ? "" : "s")} of Flammable. The wave deals {(SkillBurnMultiplier - 1f) * 100f:F0}% increased damage against Burning targets.\n\nInflicts Burn on targets hit.
sections.details: Aim a direction. After a brief delay, a Fire Wave sweeps across the entire map, dealing [({SData?.skillBaseDamage ?? 200f:F0}) + ({dpl:F0}/Lvl.) + {skillDamageMultiplier * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] damage to everything in its path, applying [({SData?.skillFlammableStacks ?? 2}) + ({fpl:F1}/Lvl.)] stacks of Flammable. The wave deals [({SData?.skillBurnMultiplier ?? 2f:F1}) + ({bpl:F1}/Lvl.)]x damage against Burning targets.\n\nInflicts Burn on targets hit.
upgrades: Increase Fire Wave damage by {dpl:F0} per level. [+{dpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase Fire Wave radius by {wpl * 0.5f:F1} per level. [+{wpl * 0.5f * effectivePath3Level:F1}]
Increase Burning-target bonus damage by {bpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{bpl * effectivePath3Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase Flammable stacks applied by {fpl:F1} per level. [+{Mathf.RoundToInt(fpl * effectivePath3Level)}]
sections.maxBonus: The Fire Wave returns after reaching its end, sweeping back in the opposite direction.

plants.name: Sunflower
plants.overview: The {GetName()} shoots her targets with sun bolts and generate precious <color=yellow>Sun</color> for the garden.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: The {DisplayName} charges up a solar-powered energy orb then shoots it towards her target, dealing {attackDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}.
sections.details: The {DisplayName} charges up a solar-powered energy orb then shoots it towards her target, dealing [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {adpl:F0} per level. [+{adpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Reduce Total Attack Damage by 50%. Attacks now shoot {projectileCount} projectiles to the target.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: The {DisplayName} periodically generates {sunGenerated} Sun every {SunGenInterval:F1} seconds. Attacks reduce the cooldown by {cooldownReductionPerHit:F2} seconds.
sections.details: The {DisplayName} periodically generates [({SFData?.baseSunGenerated ?? 10}) + ({sunpl}/Lvl.)] Sun every {data.basePassiveCooldown:F0} seconds. Attacks reduce the cooldown by [({SFData?.baseCooldownReductionPerHit ?? 0.35f:F2}) + ({cdrpl:F2}/Lvl.)] seconds.
upgrades: Increase Sun Generated by {sunpl} per level. [+{sunpl * effectivePath2Level}]
Increase cooldown reduction on hit by {cdrpl:F2}s per level. [+{cdrpl * effectivePath2Level:F2}s]
sections.maxBonus: Dealing Fire Damage inflicts Sun Mark for {SunMarkDuration:F0}s, increasing the Sun yield of the target by 27%.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Conjures a large burst of solar energy and unleashes it, calling down a scorching beam from above dealing {(SFData?.baseSunrayDPS ?? 0f) + dpspl * effectivePath3Level:F0} [+{skillDamageMultiplier * magicPower:F0}] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} per second to insects within the designated area for {skillDuration} seconds.\n\nFor each insect affected, reduce the damage by 10% down to a minimum of 50%.
sections.details: Conjures a large burst of solar energy and unleashes it, calling down a scorching beam from above dealing [({SFData?.baseSunrayDPS ?? 0f:F0}) + ({dpspl:F0}/Lvl.) + {skillDamageMultiplier * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} per second to insects within a [({SFData?.baseSunrayDiameter ?? 2f:F2}) + ({diameterpl:F2}/Lvl.)] tile wide area for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F1}) + ({durpl:F1}/Lvl.)] seconds.\n\nFor each insect affected, reduce the damage by 10% down to a minimum of 50%.
upgrades: Increase damage by {dpspl:F0} per level. [+{dpspl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase duration by {durpl:F1} second per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F1}]
Increase diameter by {diameterpl:F2} per level. [+{diameterpl * effectivePath3Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Unleashes an additional Sunray at a random insect's location on the map.

plants.name: Tansy
plants.overview: The {GetName()} is circled by an orbiting petal projectile and can summon one to infuse allies with fire energy.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Two orbiting petal projectiles, evenly spaced, each deal {EffectiveAttackDamage():F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to any insect they pass through.
sections.details: Two orbiting petal projectiles, evenly spaced, each deal [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to any insect they pass through. Their orbit radius is a fixed, togglable value from 1 up to {MaxOrbitRadius} (Attack Range, rounded down), completing [100% Attack Speed] revolutions per second regardless of radius - a wider radius means a faster-moving projectile covering more ground per lap, not slower revolutions.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {adpl:F0} per level. [+{adpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rangepl:F1} per level. [+{rangepl * effectivePath1Level:F1}]
sections.maxBonus: A third petal projectile joins the orbit, all three staying evenly spaced.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Illuminate the surrounding area allowing plants to see insects. Base Illumination Range is equal to Attack Range. The radius of the orbital may be toggled from 1 to {MaxOrbitRadius}. For each integer of radius above 1, increase Attack and Skill damage by {DistanceBonusDamagePerRadius * 100f:F0}%. Each insect an orbiting petal (Attack or Skill) hits reduces its damage by 10%, down to a minimum of 50% - resetting back to full the moment it completes a lap.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Range by {rangepl:F1} per level. [+{rangepl * effectivePath2Level:F1}]
Increase Distance Bonus Damage by {distpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{distpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
sections.maxBonus: Plants within illumination range gain Tansy's Light, increasing Attack Speed by 15%.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Target a plant anywhere on the field to grant Floral Glow for {skillDuration:F0}s, summoning an orbiting petal projectile around it that deals {EffectiveSkillDamageCoordinated():F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, sourced from the {GetName()}, to anything it passes through. Emits light equal to Tansy's Base Illumination Range.
sections.details: Target a plant anywhere on the field to grant Floral Glow for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] seconds, summoning an orbiting petal projectile around it that deals [({TData?.floralGlowBaseDamage ?? 20f:F0}) + ({dmgpl:F0}/Lvl.)] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}, sourced from the {GetName()}, to anything it passes through - its orbit speed is driven by the bearer's Attack Speed instead of Tansy's. Emits light equal to Tansy's Base Illumination Range.
upgrades: Increase duration by {durpl:F0} seconds per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase Damage by {dmgpl:F0} per level. [+{dmgpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
sections.maxBonus: A second petal projectile orbits the bearer opposite the first, equidistant at all times.

plants.name: Waterlily
plants.overview: The {GetName()} shoots her targets with little bubbles that soak surrounding insects. She can also imprison her foes with her larger bubble, leaving them exposed to her allies.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: {GetAttackDescription()} Splash hits the {SplashTargets} nearest insects around the target.
sections.details: Blows little bubbles towards her target, dealing [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)}. Splash hits the [({WLData?.splashMaxExtraTargets ?? 2}) + ({targetspl}/Lvl.)] nearest insects around the target.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Damage by {dmgpl:F0} per level. [+{dmgpl * effectivePath1Level:F0}]
Increase splash targets by {targetspl} per level. [+{targetspl * effectivePath1Level}]
Increase Base Attack Range by {rangepl:F1} per level. [+{rangepl * effectivePath1Level:F1}]
sections.maxBonus: Dealing damage to an insect at max Soaked stacks Stuns it for {MaxSoakStunDuration:F1}s.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: {SplashLine()}\n\n{SoakLine()}
sections.details: Attacks deal [{SplashDamageRatio * 100f:F0}% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to the {SplashTargets} nearest insects around the target within a [({WLData?.baseAoERange ?? 0.75f:F2}) + ({aoepl:F2}/Lvl.)] radius.\n\nDealing damage with attacks and splash damage inflicts a stacking Soaked for [({WLData?.baseSoakDuration ?? 4f:F1}) + ({soakpl:F1}/Lvl.)] [+{(WLData?.soakDurationMP ?? 1f):F1}s per 100 Magic Power] seconds, slowing by {SoakedEffect.baseSoakSlowness * 100f:F0}% + {SoakedEffect.soakSlownessPerLevel * 100f:F0}% per stack, up to {MaxSoakStacks} stacks. Soaked insects are grounded.
upgrades: Increase Soaked duration by {soakpl:F1}s per level. [+{soakpl * effectivePath2Level:F1}s]
Increase splash radius by {aoepl:F2} per level. [+{aoepl * effectivePath2Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Inflicts two stacks of Soaked instead of one.

sections.title: Skill
sections.overview: Blow a large bubble onto a targetted area, trapping insects within the bubble while dealing {bubbleDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} upon impact, and keeping them airborne for {skillDuration:F1} [+{BubbleDurationMP:F1}] seconds within a {skillAoERadius:F1} radius.\n\nImprisoned insects take {DamageTakenBase * 100f:F0}% [+{DamageTakenMP * 100f:F0}%] increased damage from all sources.
sections.details: Blows a large bubble onto a targeted area, trapping insects within the bubble while dealing {bubbleDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} upon impact, and keeping them airborne for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] [+{(WLData?.bubbleDurationMP ?? 2f):F1}s per 100 Magic Power] seconds within a [({data.baseSkillRadius:F1}) + ({radiuspl:F2}/Lvl.)] radius.\n\nImprisoned insects take [({(WLData?.baseBubbleDamageTaken ?? 0.08f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({takenpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] [+{(WLData?.bubbleDamageTakenMP ?? 0.05f) * 100f:F0}% per 100 Magic Power] increased damage from all sources.
upgrades: Increase damage taken by imprisoned insects by {takenpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{takenpl * effectivePath3Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase duration by {durpl:F0} seconds per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}]
Increase bubble radius by {radiuspl:F2} per level. [+{radiuspl * effectivePath3Level:F2}]
sections.maxBonus: Imprisoned insects slowly rise during the effect, taking fall damage when it ends. When the bubble pops, insects inside are left at full Soaked stacks.

plants.name: Zinnia
plants.overview: The {GetName()} ignites the battlefield with fiery synergy, burning nearby insects and marking nearby plants with Ablaze, empowering them with fire and magic.

sections.title: Attack
sections.overview: Releases fiery sparks dealing {attackDamage:F0} {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to all insects in range. Nearby plants instead take no damage and are marked with Ablaze, causing their next projectile attack to deal {AblazeBonusDamage:F0} + {AblazeMaxHealthPercent * 100f:F0}% of the target's Max Health as bonus Fire Magic damage.
sections.details: Releases fiery sparks dealing [100% Attack Damage] {PlantData.DamageTypeLabel(damageType)} to all insects in range. Nearby plants instead take no damage and are marked with Ablaze, causing their next projectile attack to deal [({ZData?.baseDetonationFlat ?? 15f:F0}) + ({(ZData?.baseDetonationMultiplier ?? 0.6f) * 100f:F0}% Magic Power)] + [({(ZData?.baseAblazeMaxHealthPercent ?? 0.03f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({ablazepl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.)] of the target's Max Health as bonus Fire Magic damage.
upgrades: Increase Base Attack Speed by {aspl:F2} per level. [+{aspl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Attack Range by {arpl:F2} per level. [+{arpl * effectivePath1Level:F2}]
Increase Ablaze Max Health damage by {ablazepl * 100f:F1}% per level. [+{ablazepl * effectivePath1Level * 100f:F1}%]
sections.maxBonus: Increases {GetName()}'s own Attack Speed by {maxAS * 100f:F0}%.

sections.title: Passive
sections.overview: Plants within her attack radius gain Zinnia's Warmth, increasing Fire Damage by {FireDamageBonusBase * 100f:F0}% [+{FireDamageBonusMP * 100f:F0}%] and Magic Power by {MagicPowerBonus:F0}.
sections.details: Plants within her attack radius gain Zinnia's Warmth, increasing Fire Damage by [({(ZData?.baseFireDamageBonus ?? 0f) * 100f:F0}%) + ({fdpl * 100f:F0}%/Lvl.) + {fdMult * 100f:F0}% Magic Power] and Magic Power by [({(ZData?.baseMagicPowerBonus ?? 0f):F0}) + ({mppl:F0}/Lvl.)].
upgrades: Increase Fire Damage bonus by {fdpl * 100f:F0}% per level. [+{fdpl * effectivePath2Level * 100f:F0}%]
Increase Magic Power bonus by {mppl:F0} per level. [+{mppl * effectivePath2Level:F0}]
sections.maxBonus: Plants affected by Zinnia's Warmth also gain {eaBon * 100f:F0}% Elemental Affinity.

sections.overview: Gather energy from within to conjure an Artificial Sun that shines within a radius of {ArtificialSunRadius:F1} for {skillDuration:F0} seconds. Plants illuminated by the sunlight receive the effects of being Exposed to Sunlight at intensity {SunIntensity}. The Artificial Sun also emits heat, warming up plants for {SunHeatingPerSecond:F1} per second.
sections.details: Gather energy from within to conjure an Artificial Sun that shines within a radius of {ArtificialSunRadius:F1} for [({data.baseSkillDuration:F0}) + ({durpl:F0}/Lvl.)] seconds. Plants illuminated by the sunlight receive the effects of being Exposed to Sunlight at intensity [({ZData?.baseSkillIntensity ?? 0}) + ({sipl}/Lvl.)]. The Artificial Sun also emits heat, warming up plants for [({baseHeat:F1}) + ({heatpl:F1}/Lvl.)] per second.
upgrades: Increase Artificial Sun lifetime by {durpl:F0} seconds per level. [+{durpl * effectivePath3Level:F0}s]
Increase intensity by {sipl} per level. [{SunIntensity}]
Increase warming by {heatpl:F1} per second per level. [+{heatpl * effectivePath3Level:F1}]
